t: Introduction and overview — King George V-class Battleship
name: Introduction and overview — King George V-class Battleship — ship record
title: Introduction and overview — King George V-class Battleship
description: Introduction and overview of the King George V-class Battleship: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The Royal Navy's King George V class — five ships — were Britain's WWII battleships: 42,200 tons with ten 14-inch guns in three turrets. Prince of Wales was sunk by Japanese aircraft in 1941 with Repulse; Duke of York sank the Scharnhorst in 1943. The class served in every theater. Baseline facts: Royal Navy WWII battleship; 5 built; ten 14-inch guns; every theater..
